cherry_assistant.description: Built-in Cherry Studio advisor. Diagnose issues, guide operations, collect FAQs, submit bugs/feature requests, and search/create Skills

workspace_status.not_directory: Workspace path is not a directory: {{path}}

docs.description: OpenAI-, Anthropic- and Gemini-compatible HTTP API for Cherry Studio, plus Cherry-specific endpoints (models, knowledge bases)

operations.chat_completions: Create a chat completion. Request and response bodies follow the OpenAI Chat Completions format; set `stream: true` for incremental output.
operations.count_tokens: Estimate how many input tokens a set of Anthropic-format messages uses.
operations.generate_content: Generate content through Gemini's `generateContent` method. Request and response bodies follow the Gemini API format; `streamGenerateContent` is served on the same path.
operations.get_knowledge_base: Fetch a single knowledge base by ID.
operations.health: Service health, current time and version. No authentication required.
operations.info: API name, version and the main endpoints. No authentication required.
operations.list_knowledge_bases: List the knowledge bases available in this Cherry Studio instance.
operations.list_models: List the models available through this gateway, in the OpenAI models format.
operations.messages: Create a message. Request and response bodies follow the Anthropic Messages format; set `stream: true` for incremental output.
operations.responses: Create a response. Request and response bodies follow the OpenAI Responses format.
operations.search_knowledge_bases: Search one or more knowledge bases and return the matching document chunks.

tags.anthropic: Anthropic-compatible endpoints. Point an Anthropic SDK at this gateway's base URL to use them.
tags.cherry: Cherry Studio's own endpoints: knowledge bases, service info and health check.
tags.gemini: Gemini-compatible endpoints, served under `/v1beta` like the upstream API.
tags.openai: OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Point an OpenAI SDK at this gateway's base URL to use them.

data_reset.message: This will erase chats, assistants, knowledge bases, files, and settings, then restart the app. This action cannot be undone. Continue?
data_reset.title: Reset App Data

errors.binary_incompatible: The OpenClaw binary used by Cherry Studio is incompatible with the generated configuration. Upgrade OpenClaw.{{details}}
errors.external_config_invalid: OpenClaw rejected configuration outside Cherry Studio's managed provider section. Fix that configuration or upgrade OpenClaw.{{details}}
errors.preflight_failed: Cherry Studio could not validate the OpenClaw configuration.
